queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  TimeoutEvent "\"operationName\":\"TimeoutEvent\""
| json "LogicalServerName", "SubscriptionId", "ResourceGroup", "resourceId", "category", "operationName", "properties" nodrop
| json field=properties "ElasticPoolName", "DatabaseName", "error_state"
| where operationName="TimeoutEvent"
|where if ("{{resourceid}}" = "*", true, resourceid matches "{{resourceid}}") AND if ("{{subscriptionid}}" = "*", true, subscriptionid matches "{{subscriptionid}}") AND if ("{{operationname}}" = "*", true, operationname matches "{{operationname}}") AND if ("{{error_state}}" = "*", true, error_state matches "{{error_state}}") AND if ("{{elasticpoolname}}" = "*", true, elasticpoolname matches "{{elasticpoolname}}") AND if ("{{logicalservername}}" = "*", true, logicalservername matches "{{logicalservername}}") AND if ("{{resourcegroup}}" = "*", true, resourcegroup matches "{{resourcegroup}}") AND if ("{{category}}" = "*", true, category matches "{{category}}") AND if ("{{databasename}}" = "*", true, databasename matches "{{databasename}}")
|count as eventCount by DatabaseName
| top 10 DatabaseName by eventCount, DatabaseName asc
